<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. IIII.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|9}}</noinclude>saluation, but it is ynough to be borne of Christian parents, and such like erroneous positions wel knowen among the Caluinists.

''12. Floore.''] This floore is his Church militant here in earth, wherein are both good and bad (here signified by corne and chaffe) til the separation be made in the day of iudgement: contrarie to the doctrine of the Heretikes, that hold, the Church to consist onely of the good.

''16. Opened.''] To signifie that heauen was shut in the old law, til Christ by his Passion opened it, and so by his Ascension was the first that entered into it; contrarie to the doctrine of the Heretikes. ''See Hebr. 9, 8''. and''11, 40''.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. IIII.}}}}}}

{{c|''Christ going into the desert to prepare him self before his Manifestation, ouercometh the Deuils tentations. 12 Beginning in Galilee, as the Prophet said he should: 18 he calleth foure Disciples: and with his preaching and miracles draweth vnto him innumerable folowers.''}} {{dropinitial|T|fl={{verse|chapter=4|verse=1}}}}HEN {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 1, 12. Lu. 4, 1.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the first Sunday in Lent.}}{{sc|Iesvs}} was ledde of the Spirit into the {{sup|‖}} desert, to be tempted of the Deuil. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=2}}† And vvhen he had {{sup|‖}} fasted fourtie daies and fourtie nightes, aftervvard he vvas hungrie. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=3}}† And the tempter approched & sayd to him, If thou be the sonne of God, commaund that these stones be made bread. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=4}}† VVho ansvvered & said, It is vvritten, ''Not in bread alone doth man liue, but in euery word that procedeth from the mouth of God''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 8, 3.''}}

{{verse|chapter=4|verse=5}}† Then the Deuil tooke him vp into the holy citie, and set him vpon the pinnacle of the Tēple, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=6}}† and sayd to him, If thou be the sonne of God, cast thy self dovvne, for {{sup|‖}} it is vvritten. ''That he wil giue his Angels charge of thee, & in their hands shal they hold thee vp, lest perhaps thou knocke they foote agaynst a stone''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 90, 12.''}} {{verse|chapter=4|verse=7}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} sayd to him againe, It is vvritten, ''Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 6, 16.''}} {{verse|chapter=4|verse=8}}† Againe the Deuil tooke him vp into a very high mountaine: and he shevved him al the Kingdoms of the vvorld, and the glorie of them, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=9}}† and sayd to him, Al these vvil I giue thee, if falling dovvne thou vvilt adore me. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=10}}† Then {{sc|Iesvs}} sayth to him, Auant Satan: for it is written, ''The Lord thy God shalt thou adore, & {{sup|‖}} him onely shalt thou serue''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 6, 13.''}} {{verse|chapter=4|verse=11}}† Then the Deuil left him: and behold Angels came, and ministred to him.⊣

{{verse|chapter=4|verse=12}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 1, 14. Luc. 4, 14.''}}* vvhen {{sc|Iesvs}} had heard that Iohn vvas deliuered vp, he retyred into Galilee:{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=THE THIRD part of the Gospel, of Christs manifesting him self by preaching, and that in Galilee.}} {{verse|chapter=4|verse=13}}† and leauing the citie Nazareth, came & dvvelt in Capharnaum a sea tovvne, in the borders of Zabulon & Nephthali, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=14}}† that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas sayd by Esay the Prophet. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=15}}† ''Land of Zabulon & land of Nephthali, the way of the sea beyond Iordan of Galilee, of the Gentils'':{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 9, 1.''}} {{verse|chapter=4|verse=16}}† ''the people that sate in darknesse, hath seen great light'': and to them that sate in a countrey of the shadow of death, ''light is risen to them''. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=17}}† From that time {{sc|Iesvs}} began to<noinclude>{{rh||B|preach,}}</noinclude>
